fact: The SIXP administrator told AfPIF 2015 that the Serekunda Internet Exchange Point (AS37698), established in July 2014, is the first and only IXP in The Gambia and has seven ASNs peering.
Traffic: 50.541 Mbit/s (maximum reached) at SIXP, Serekunda, as stated by the SIXP administrator; the deck gives no date for the peak, so the talk date of 26 August 2015 is used.

The Internet Society reports that the first Internet Exchange Point in The Gambia, the Serrekunda Internet Exchange Point (SIXP), was launched on 12 July 2014 in Banjul with African Union AXIS support.
